Security and Privacy

How can I use digital tools safely?

Short Answer

Use approved tools, keep devices and accounts secure, check sharing settings and seek advice if you are unsure whether information can be entered or shared.

Detailed Guidance

Use agency-approved tools and keep devices, software and accounts protected using current agency advice. Check sharing and access settings before sending information, avoid entering sensitive details into unapproved services, and contact your service desk when unsure.
